The field value will be a valid record URL in the form `https://my.living-apps.de/rest/apps/6ad3100a83f2147ed4c1684f/records/<record-id>` (or `null`/`None`).

When writing, either pass a record URL through exactly as this API returned it, or send the portable relative form `/apps/6ad3100a83f2147ed4c1684f/records/<record-id>`. Other equivalent record-URL forms are accepted as well.

Displayed as single-select field in HTML pages.
